Probiotics

“One size fits all” does not work for probiotics. Various strains and dos-

ages are recommended for various goals. The Clinical Guide to Probiotic

Products can help you determine which probiotic might be suited for a

specific health issue.

www.usprobioticguide.com (U.S. products)

www.probioticchart.ca/PBC AdultHealth.html (Canadian products)
